goal: The 5180 demo works offline and answers every time the owner opens it: the daily offline walk of the 6 apps passes with 0 outside requests, /health answers within 3 s, the dev server goes down unplanned at most once a day (a deliberate pm2 restart or stop and a restart a vite config edit asks for do not count), and no page hangs on an SSR timeout. Tell the owner only when 5180 stays down for over an hour.

onMiss: The demo runs only on the owner's Mac (10-19), on branch dev/sieun-mac-a in ~/Documents/Github/auto-sns-agent, so every step below runs there over `ssh mac`, and every browser check is headless (c103). Every run, once /health answers, run the offline walk behind the load gate with exactly `ssh mac 'export PATH=/Users/sieunpark/.hermes/node/bin:$PATH; cd ~/Documents/Github/auto-sns-agent/apps/virev-demo && PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE=$PWD/../../.cache/duties/virev-demo-offline.json ../../node_modules/.bin/playwright test tests/e2e/offline.spec.ts --reporter=json 2> ../../.cache/duties/virev-demo-offline.err'`. The PATH line is the precheck's, since a plain `ssh mac` PATH has no node and playwright then fails with `env: node: No such file or directory`; a walk_command slice names such a failure from the .err file. Each missed metric gets one fix job, or a steer to its live one. walk_problems: a job that makes the fake database answer each outside request, or fixes the failed page. health_ms: read virev-demo-error.log on the Mac; with no 200 in 30 s, run `pm2 restart virev-demo` once on the Mac (PM2_HOME=.cache/pm2-dev) and start a job on the cause. restarts_24h: steer "5180 materialize crash loop fix" for a materialize crash loop, else start a job on the cause the restart line names. ssr_timeouts_24h: steer or start "5180 SSR hang fix", which fixes the wait that never ends. Fixes are commits on dev/sieun-mac-a in the Mac checkout, pushed to origin dev/sieun-mac-a; no deploy, nothing to 5174, and no box copy of the demo. When ssh mac fails the precheck fails, which means the Mac is asleep or offline. Tell the owner only when 5180 is down over an hour.
